title: Filing-Fee Schedule for a Moved Certificate: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44)
content:
**Fee.** The moved certificate fee under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) is Cardinal Point's flat filing fee for a moved certificate: 25.00 US dollars, to the cent. A moved certificate is the state-change refiling a named insured orders for their own certificate after moving.

**New backing term.** The moved certificate rests on the new backing term. That is the term of the same kind as the one replaced, Owner Auto Policy or Named Non-Owner Policy, carrying the customer's most recent new-business premium written. This schedule covers a customer with exactly one such term written as new business on that date.

**Settlement.**

- A figure that takes the place of the flat fee is set first.
- Every amount added under the schedule is then added to that figure.
- The total is never below zero and is rounded to the cent, half up, once at the end.
- Each dimension of the schedule enters the fee once.

**Worked figure.**

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Flat moved certificate fee | 25.00 |
| Total, not below zero, rounded once to the cent | 25.00 |

**Locating the new backing term (hypothetical premium records)**

A customer's Owner Auto Policy terms show new-business premium written on these dates: one on the 4th of an earlier year, and one on the 9th of this month. The term carrying the premium written on the 9th is the new backing term.
